levels.label: M15 support (broke, then closed back above)

watchlist.missing: Break below failed: price closed back above support overnight. Needs a new close below, displacement, M5 structure break, retest and a candle trigger. Indicators: price is tangled in the EMAs and RSI is about 49, so there is no trend agreement.

Price is about 33 pips under resistance, still in the middle of the range. A rejection there would need a candle trigger, and a break above would need a close, follow-through and a retest. Indicators: price is tangled in the EMAs and RSI is about 49, so there is no trend agreement.

Short watch. Price is below support after the NFP spike (long wick to about 1.3361), but there is only one candle of follow-through, no retest yet and no engulfing or pin-bar trigger. Needs the retest of about 1.3382 to reject from below. If SL sits 2-3 pips above the retest swing, the TP must be at least 2R away. Indicators (M5 chart): EMA 20 is below EMA 50 and price is below both, which agrees with a short. RSI is about 30, at the oversold edge, so the EMA + RSI check is borderline. It fails if RSI is below 30 or turns back up at the retest.

Long watch. Price closed above resistance on a huge NFP/CAD jobs candle (wick to about 1.4113) and kept going, so close, displacement, follow-through and M5 structure all pass. Price is about 13 pips above the level and has not retested it, so there is no retest and no candle trigger. Indicators (M5 chart): EMA 20 is above EMA 50 and price is above both, but RSI is about 72 and turning down from about 78, so EMA + RSI fails. That is 4 of 6. It would need the retest to hold with an engulfing or pin bar, and RSI back under 70 and not turning against the trade. Needs 1:2 to the next S/R above.

No break yet. Price is about 158.40, between support at 157.78 and resistance at 158.67, after a news spike that wicked to about 158.60 and failed to reach the level. Indicators: EMA 20 is above EMA 50, price is above both and RSI is about 63, so the uptrend agrees with a long, but there is nothing to grade until a level closes beyond. A long needs a close above about 158.67, follow-through, an M5 structure break, a retest that holds and an engulfing or pin bar. The overnight dip under 157.78 closed back above it, so that break failed.

GBP/USD: a retest of about 1.3382 from below that rejects with an M5 bearish engulfing or pin bar. A close back above 1.3382 downgrades it and it stays C.
